structured.answer: After 8 years, putting in 500 ₪ a month, I'd have about 68,853 ₪ (48,000 of it my own money, no tax), if their assumed 7% a year holds. For 4 years the page gives self-employed people no number at all, only a note that you pay tax before 6 years.

stuck.why: The fund bar was an empty dotted box, and the only number, 25,725, was under 'אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך', which isn't the fund. It took me a moment to understand there is no figure for 4 years.
The input boxes moved around (תשואה jumped from right to left), so I had to find them again.
